now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
now.text: Phil Coulson trusts Isabelle Hartley and brings her mercenary team into his S.H.I.E.L.D. He sends her to recover a mysterious object that turns out to be the Obelisk, and she dies on that mission.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The director who hires Hartley's team and sends her after the Obelisk.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A mercenary Coulson trusts and hires. She dies on his mission.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A veteran agent Coulson trusts, with a team he hires. She dies on his mission.

changes.evidence: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1 (Shadows) Hartley is Agent Isabelle Hartley, a veteran S.H.I.E.L.D. agent; the mercenaries are Lance Hunter and Idaho, whom she leads for Coulson. 'A mercenary' on Coulson's card is wrong (stage 1's card repeats it).

now.title: Doctor Strange
now.text: Lucian tries to kill Stephen Strange, and Strange kills him in their fight in the New York Sanctum.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer Lucian tries to kill, who kills him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Zealot who tries to kill Strange. Strange kills him in the Sanctum.

proposed.text: Lucian stabs Stephen Strange in the New York Sanctum and follows his astral form to a hospital, where Strange kills him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Zealot who tries to kill Strange. Strange kills him in an astral fight.

changes.evidence: Doctor Strange: in the New York Sanctum the Cloak only subdues Lucian after he stabs Strange. Lucian's astral form follows Strange to Metro-General Hospital, where Strange, charged by Christine's defibrillator, destroys it, killing him. The killing is not 'in their fight in the New York Sanctum'.

now.title: Marvel Zombies
now.text: The sorcerers of Kamar-Taj lead the stand against Wanda's horde in Paris, and all three fall.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Defend the Hulk from Wanda in Paris.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Sends her horde against the sorcerers in Paris.

changes.evidence: The sorcerers' stand against Wanda's horde in Paris, and the deaths of Rintrah, Sara and the London Master, all happen in Episode 4. The bare show title puts these deaths from episode 1 on (the data uses #N for this show elsewhere, e.g. Marvel Zombies#1).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7
now.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and begins to doubt him. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and locks her up to take her powers, and she ends up fighting at Daisy's side against him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Killed Kora's mother. Now her enemy.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Learns Nathaniel killed Jiaying and turns on him.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
proposed.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and begins to doubt him. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.

changes.evidence: Stage 1 sits on a bare 'S7' after stage 0 at S7#11. Kora sees Jiaying's body at the end of S7#11 (Brand New Day) but still kisses Nathaniel; in S7#12 (The End Is at Hand) she confronts him, lets Daisy go, and he shoots her and has her held. Draining her powers and her fighting beside S.H.I.E.L.D. come in S7#13 (What We're Fighting For), so they are cut from this stage (they could be a further stage at S7#13).

owner_calls.question: Stage 1 (X-Men '97#18) keeps kind 'boss', but by the end of #18 Jubilee leaves Cable's X-Force for the X-Men after he tries to kill the unconscious Gambit (and in #19 X-Force attacks X-Corp). Keep 'boss', or change the kind?
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men '97 #18: 'After Cable attempts to kill the unconscious Gambit, Jubilee and Sunspot leave with the X-Men.' #19: 'X-Force and X-Factor attack X-Corp.'
